notes.title: 15 Achievements Implemented
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I was able to get all 15 achievements for Muzzleloaded implemented! I made a few other pause game and gamepad fixes.  I hope you enjoy!  Thank you!

Sincerely,
Jordan Keith

notes.title: Release Date:
notes.notes: My official release date for Muzzleloaded is 12/21/2018!  Big thanks to everyone who wishlisted my game so far and Huge thanks to Play, Enjoy, Write Reviews for your review!
